_help: Hand-written facts about each vehicle. tools/build_manifest.py merges this with the image files it finds under assets/sets/<vehicle>/<set>/NNN.(png|webp|jpg). carBox is [left, top, right, bottom] of the car body as fractions of the image. nose says which way the front of the car points: 'left' or 'right'. Both can be a single value (applies to every frame) or a list with one value per frame.
